name: Seapunk
summary: Turquoise and aqua water, dolphins, shells, floating 3D shapes and tie-dye, with 1990s web graphics. It started as a joke tweet in 2011 and grew into an ocean theme in music and fashion.

philosophy.core_thesis: Put the early web underwater: its 3D shapes, clip art and gradients float on a sea of turquoise.
design_principles: Set the ground as a vertical gradient from aqua (#7FFFD4) at the top to deep sea blue (#0B3D91) at the bottom.
Float 3 to 6 glossy shapes (pyramids, spheres, rings) at different sizes and let them drift over the layout.
Place one marine motif at 30% to 50% of the frame: a dolphin, a shell or a wave.
Set the display text with 2 colour stops from #00F5D4 to #9B5DE5 and a 2px dark edge.
Overlay a tie-dye or wave pattern at 15% opacity on one panel.
Add a pixel sparkle of 8px at 4 or more points of the frame.
Keep the text panels on a deep sea ground (#0B3D91) with text at 7:1 contrast.
anti_patterns: Realistic ocean photographs with no digital layer

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose 12-column grid with 16px gutters; panels and shapes overlap by 8px to 32px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: A centred hero and offset panels; floating shapes sit off the grid at angles of -12° to 12°.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 12px radius and a 2px aqua edge; pill buttons; circles and rings as accents.

font_pairings.note: A soft, bubbly display face with a round text face.
A rounded sans for headings and a plain text face.
A bitmap face for the net art side, with a mono text face.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set display text in 2-stop gradient colour.
Use a pixel face only for labels of 12px or less.

color.palette_structure: Aqua and turquoise on deep sea blue, with a lilac and a pink accent.
color.contrast_rules: Text on deep sea blue holds at least 7:1; aqua and lilac carry headings and shapes, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Vertical water gradients; glossy 2-stop gradients on 3D shapes; a tie-dye wash on one panel.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft highlight at the top left of each shape; a glow of 12px in aqua; no hard black shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Water and clear plastic, as early 3D software drew them: smooth, glossy and a little flat.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px aqua edge on panels; a 1px white highlight line inside.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A glow of 12px blur on shapes; panels have a 6px soft shadow in deep blue.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 24px with round forms and a 2px edge: shells, waves, stars and a dolphin.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Dolphins, mermaid tails, shells, pyramids and rings in a 1990s 3D look, on a water texture.

motion.transition_physics: Shapes drift up and down by 12px to 24px over 6s; the water gradient shifts by 10% over 12s; panels fade in over 500ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises a shape by 8px and adds a 16px aqua glow; the active state shifts the gradient by 20%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful and dreamy, as if inside an old screensaver aquarium.

avoid_when: The audience expects a calm, formal tone.
The brand needs a serious or medical voice.

modifiers.how: Replace the tie-dye with soft sky blue, add glossy bubbles and keep the water gradient.
Change the ground to night violet and add a perspective grid and a sun disc.
Replace the 3D shapes with pixel sprites and use a bitmap face for all labels.

pack.why: Rounded, filled icons match the glossy, bubble-like shapes of 1990s 3D water graphics.

ground.why: Seapunk floats glossy shapes in water, so the ground is a field of bubbles on a water gradient.
